description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Pious Evangel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus artifact token.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Pious Evangel trigger.
Resolve the Pious Evangel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat
